senses.gloss: (b. h.) pr. n. m. Shem, son of Noah.
units: <cite ref="Megillah 9b:4">Meg. 9ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 9:27">Gen. IX, 27</cite>) <he>דבריו … באהלי שם</he> let the speech of Japheth (Greek) dwell in the tents of Shem; v. <cite ref="J00505"><he>יָפְיוּת</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 63:10">Gen. R. s. 63</cite>, v. <cite ref="P00061"><he>עֵבֶר</he> I</cite>.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 18:6">Ex. R. s. 18</cite> the Lord said, <he>חייב אני לשם אביהם וכ׳</he> I am indebted to their (the Assyrians’) father Shem, because he and Japheth took their cloaks and covered with it &c.; a. fr.
